title: Scout craft powering up and accelerating at 8,000 to 12,000 mph

tellings.quote: One of the things I personally watched them do from a distance cuz if you get too close the fields will burn you like a microwave,

plain: Charles Hall, a former Air Force weather observer, says that between 1965 and 1967, in Indian Springs Valley in Nevada, he watched small scout craft belonging to tall white beings power up and race off at 8,000 to 12,000 miles per hour. He says he watched from a distance because getting too close meant the craft's fields would burn you like a microwave. If true, it would mean non-human beings were operating craft near a US military range.
